description: Generate a corrected version of SFMC code based on validation diagnostics. Returns the original code with inline fix suggestions or a corrected replacement. Set target to 'next' to include MCN platform compatibility in the analysis.

code.description: The SFMC code snippet to fix.

issueDescription.description: Optional human description of the specific issue to fix.

language.description: Language of the code. Defaults to "auto".

target.description: Target platform. Use 'next' to flag MCN-incompatible functions and SSJS usage.

name: suggest_fix
